rhs_for_integrator: E_total*(kcat_forward*A*B/(alpha_AB*K_A*K_B) - kcat_reverse*P*Q/(K_P*K_Q))/(1 + A/K_A + B/K_B + A*B/(alpha_AB*K_A*K_B) + P/K_P + Q/K_Q + P*Q/(K_P*K_Q) + A*Q/(alpha_AQ*K_A*K_Q) + B*P/(alpha_BP*K_B*K_P) + A**2/(K_A*K_A_inhibitory) + B**2/(K_B*K_B_inhibitory))
sanity_expectations: J_net is a smooth real function of (A, B, P, Q); denominator is 1 + sum of positive terms, strictly >= 1, so no singularities in the sampled box.
Sign(J_net) changes: J_net > 0 when kcat_forward*A*B/(alpha_AB*K_A*K_B) > kcat_reverse*P*Q/(K_P*K_Q) and < 0 otherwise; the surface crosses zero continuously.

At fixed A, P, Q, J_net first rises with B; at sufficiently large B the new B^2/(K_B*K_B_inhibitory) denominator term causes substrate inhibition and J_net turns over (non-monotone in B). Analogously non-monotone in A via the A^2 term.
|J_net| is bounded by ~E_total*max(kcat_forward, kcat_reverse) = 1 in the chosen units.

In the limit A,B -> 0 (with P,Q fixed) J_net -> -E_total*kcat_reverse*P*Q/(K_P*K_Q) / (denominator without A,B terms); in the limit P,Q -> 0 J_net -> +E_total*kcat_forward*A*B/(alpha_AB*K_A*K_B) / (denominator without P,Q terms).
excitation_report: excitation_check (sigma=0.02, k=5, Sobol 512 pts over 4D): total-expression rms = 0.2196 -> 10.98*sigma. No weak terms flagged. auto_balance converged with no coefficient rescaling.
role_corrections: A: V->V (confirmed, sampled concentration axis, 0.1-10 mM)
B: V->V (confirmed, sampled concentration axis; range extends to 10 mM so the new B^2 inhibition term becomes visible)
P: V->V (confirmed, sampled concentration axis, 0.1-10 mM)
Q: V->V (confirmed, sampled concentration axis, 0.1-10 mM)
K_B_inhibitory: P->P (confirmed; fixed at 5 mM, well inside the suggested 0.01-100 mM log-uniform range, so the new B^2 term is excited within a physiological B window)
rationale: Structural analysis (analyze_expression): no derivatives, no integrals, no functional f(t); target J_net does not appear on the RHS and is explicitly solvable -> equation_type=explicit, integrator=evaluate_explicit. Roles: J_net is the output; the four solute concentrations A, B, P, Q are the sampled axes (matches the phenomenon statement "all four solute concentrations are independently varied"); every remaining free symbol is a fixed parameter. Parameter magnitudes chosen at physiologically typical enzyme-kinetics scales (Km ~ 1 mM, kcat ~ 10-100 /s, E_total in the ~10 uM range). alpha_AB=1 (no productive-binding cooperativity); alpha_AQ=alpha_BP=2 (mild disfavour for nonproductive cross-complexes); inhibition constants K_A_inhibitory=K_B_inhibitory=5 mM sit well inside the suggested 0.01-100 mM log-uniform range so substrate inhibition bites within the sampled B window. The sampling box [0.1, 10] mM for each substrate spans below-Km through several-Km, letting the flux pass through zero (forward/reverse balance) and letting the new B^2/(K_B*K_B_inhibitory) inhibition term become visible at the high-B corner. auto_balance converged in one shot and excitation_check confirms 5*sigma satisfied for the total signal (10.98x) and 7.59*sigma for the new-term contribution vs the parent.
